exclusions.what: Strict, intermediate and relaxed groups, logMAR BCVA at months 0-18 and letter changes (Table 4, pone.0271999.t004!R14-R18 and R20-R23, C2-C4)
exclusions.reason: Groups defined after baseline, by the fluid-tolerance ratio over the 18-month follow-up (post-baseline fluid status and treatment decisions).

Analysis set selected by a post-baseline outcome (only eyes with persistent or recurrent fluid from month 3 to month 18; eyes dry at every visit after the loading injections were excluded) and complete-case (follow-up shorter than 18 months, the last tabulated visit, and any missing data at months 3, 6, 12 or 18 were exclusion criteria); protocol inclusion 5.

exclusions.what: Baseline BCVA (Table 1, pone.0271999.t001!R7) and regression analyses (Tables 2 and 5)
exclusions.reason: Baseline only; model estimates are not admissible.

notes: Eyes with anti-VEGF injection within 1 year before the first injection were excluded (treatment-naive within that year); one eye per patient (the worse eye).
Central retinal thickness, fluid components and injection numbers are not extracted.
